item.title: Pheditor Terminal Handler OS Command Injection to RCE (CVE-2026-48030)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.9) — web · CVE-2026-48030. Status: Weaponized (complete authenticated exploit that injects through the dir parameter, reads command output and confirms execution with the uid string; no successful run is published in the repository). Affects: Pheditor, a single-file PHP editor and file manager by Hamid Samak. Tags: pheditor, php, command-injection, terminal, whitelist-bypass, authenticated, rce, webshell, cwe-78.
